# Lua API

<!-- Auto-generated by `cargo xtask gen-lua-docs`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Reference for every namespace exposed under the global `smelt` table. Rust-registered signatures come from the closure's argument and return types; bundled Lua signatures come from LuaCATS annotations beside the implementation.

**Coverage:** 93 namespace(s), 450 function(s), 111 class(es), 13 alias(es).

Namespaces marked *UI only* need the terminal UI and raise in headless mode. *Advanced* namespaces are low-level building blocks that may change more freely. For a guided introduction, see [Extend smelt](../../extend/index.md).

## IDE completion

smelt mirrors type stubs for every namespace to `builtins/lua/smelt/_meta/` in its data directory. Point lua-language-server at it for completions and diagnostics; see [Editor setup](../../extend/index.md#editor-setup).

- [`smelt`](index_smelt.md) (some UI only): Root smelt namespace. 1 advanced function(s).

- [`smelt.settings`](settings.md): Metatable-backed proxy table for preferences.

- [`smelt.timer`](timer.md): One-shot and recurring timer callbacks.
- [`smelt.work`](work.md) (UI only): Push background work-state tokens.
